title: Duke researchers' brain implants let paralyzed people control robot arms and walk

tellings.quote: there's Dano and this guy at um Duke who um implant electrodes in the brain of people who uh are paralyzed.

plain: Researchers at Duke University have put electrodes into the brains of paralyzed people, letting them control robot arms and even walk. Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the NSA, mentions this work to Michels and names someone he calls "Dano" and "this guy at Duke" who implant the electrodes. It comes up as an example of how close machines and minds have already been joined.
